description:
## Changes

**Consolidated 4 patches into 1:**
- Merged PremiumFeaturesPatch, UserPatches, SubscriptionDisplayPatch, and SubscriptionPatches into single `premiumUnlockPatch`
- Eliminates duplicate User class patching logic
- Combines xma privilege gates with display timestamp
- Organizes code by class target with clear section comments

**Bug fixes:**
- Fixed isUltraPremium() double-patch conflict between patches
- Added isMe() guards to isVIP/isSVIP/isPlatinum (only affects current user)
- Added isMe() guards to zva0.B0() and sb90.c() (other users show actual tier)
- Subscription management shows only Ultra-Premium as active
- Documented xma catch-all risk with TODO for explicit allowlist

## Assets

- `patches-0.0.1-dev1.mpp` - Install in Morphe Manager
- `patches-list.json` - Patch metadata
